operations.target: struct iris_FogParameters {vec4 color;float density;float start;float end;float scale;};
iris_FogParameters irisInt_Fog = iris_FogParameters(iris_FogColor, iris_FogDensity, iris_FogStart, iris_FogEnd, 1.0 / (iris_FogEnd - iris_FogStart));

referenceBehavior: Pinned CommonTransformer changes attribute/varying storage by stage, replaces gl_FragColor with gl_FragData[0], replaces indexed fragment references with explicit location-qualified vec4 outputs, and renames selected texture calls. The full Iris implementation uses AST transformations; this adapter accepts only a much narrower structural subset.
implementationScope: Owned SPK1 sources -> virtual includes -> existing GLSL preprocessor -> explicit GLSL 120 vertex/fragment pair -> Core GLSL 330 text and explicit interface/output-location metadata. No shader compilation, resource creation or production activation occurs in this API.
semantics: Output locations retain literal indices 0..7, including sparse sets. They are not attachment, colortex or Minecraft semantic IDs. Attribute names have no inferred GPU locations or data producers. Existing source version macros are already resolved from source 120 and are never re-evaluated as target 330.

supported.extensionRequests: Only literal GL_ARB_shader_texture_lod enable/require is preserved before declarations and recorded as a request, not advertised support; no extension macros are inferred.
outputs: gl_FragData[canonical single-line literal 0..7] -> matching explicit vec4 location
supported.interfaces: Individual non-array float/vector/matrix attributes and varyings; simple typed uniforms. Cross-stage varying and uniform type checks. One main definition per stage.

rejected: other versions/profiles/stages and other extension requests
structs/user-defined types/interface arrays/blocks or multiple declarators
reserved generated-name or core texture-name collisions
legacy texture overloads/prototypes, fields or non-call references
missing/mismatched stage varyings or conflicting uniform types
correctnessBoundary: Structural translation is not full GLSL type checking, AST parity or proof that arbitrary input is valid GLSL. Original and translated fixtures must pass glslang; a deliberately mistyped included source must retain its mapped diagnostic rejection. Linking/bindings, draw routing, authoritative runtime facts, full translation and image/FPS acceptance remain open.
